facts.fact: Ares 给常来岛上的 Kayla 发员工腕带，避免她被当成访客在无人陪同时被请出去
facts.anchor: It keeps her from getting confused as a guest and being made to leave if none of us are with her.

facts.fact: Luca 在简报后拦住 Ares 套话，Ares 直接回绝、否认 Kayla 与他有关
Ares 察觉 Luca 看到 Vero 陪 Kayla 时下颌紧绷，判断这是他情绪的真实泄露并记下
facts.anchor: Luca is watching the two of them, and his jaw clenches subtly. I make a note of that.

facts.fact: Ares 决定找 Clay 提醒他盯住 Luca，因为 Luca 是他尚未算清的变数
facts.anchor: I need to find Clay when I get a chance and warn him that we need to keep an eye on Luca.

facts.fact: Ares 把 Kayla 带到墓地旁只有他知道的矮石墙，并承认自己会故意制造「让人需要他」的时刻
facts.anchor: I wanted you to need me—it’s what I do. I create moments where I am needed. It’s an instinct.

facts.fact: Kayla 讲出与 Aaron 的往事：十六岁认识将满十八岁的他、十八岁生日被他带走并失去处女之身、随即同居
facts.anchor: On my eighteenth birthday, Aaron took me out, and we did all my favorite things. I lost my virginity that night.

facts.fact: Kayla 说自己留在岛上是因为这里的人把红旗摆在明面上，而 Aaron 要她只依赖他；她现在能自己决定一切
facts.anchor: But I believe your heart is in the right place, and that you are not using it to hurt anyone. Aaron purposely manipulated me in a way he knew would hurt me, and he wanted me to rely solely on him.

facts.fact: Ares 承认这是他记忆中第一次不带着目的与某人相处，同时知道自己可以拿 Kayla 的过去做筹码
facts.anchor: For the first time in as long as I can remember, I am not with someone because I have an agenda. I am here in the moment with her, and though I want to hate it, I don’t.
